failures: Measured on 2026-10-08 as a collection under the correct catalog name GOOGLE/DYNAMICWORLD/V1: it answers. 78 images fall inside 2023-01-01..2024-12-31 overlapping a point in Moscow, ten bands (water, trees, grass, flooded_vegetation, crops, shrub_and_scrub, built, bare, snow_and_ice, label), and a real class-confidence read at that point returns built 0.0931, bare 0.0638, crops 0.0408; a point in Kaliningrad returns no data. See artifacts/geo/dynamic_world_probe.json. It is still not built into a covariate layer, so the requirement stays unmet - reaching a collection is not the same as having used it. The role it was named for - land cover changing inside the observation window rather than a single snapshot - is still carried by GLC-LC100 monthly 2019, MODIS MCD12Q1 class shares and MCD64A1 burn dates, all on disk with per-row provenance. Recorded separately because the first probe here asked for NASA/DYNAMICWORLD/V1, an identifier invented in this repository rather than taken from the catalog, and reported that name's "asset not found" as a fact about our access and about Earth Engine being unreachable in general; both conclusions were wrong and are withdrawn.

ISRIC/soilgrids does not resolve; the catalog name ISRIC/SoilGrids250m/v2_0 does, measured 2026-10-08 in artifacts/geo/asset_id_probe.json. The property behind its val_* bands is not named by the collection's metadata and is identified by value range as organic carbon concentration.

Hansen/GFSID2017 and UMD/hansen-global-tree-cover do not resolve; UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2025_v1_13 does, measured the same day, with treecover2000, loss, gain and lossyear. UMD/GLAD_/TREECOVER/CIRCUITRY/2020v1 and UMD/gladsat-foundation-data-v1 still do not, and GLAD/IFL/2021 and UMD/ifl_2021 still do not - those two families were dropped by the entrant's decision on 2026-10-08, not by a source failure.
WORLDCLIM/V1/MONTHLY/PRECIP (asset not found; WORLDCLIM/V1/BIO is an Image and works)
blocked: VIIRS DNB annual composites: eogdata.mines.edu redirects to eogauth.mines.edu (Keycloak login); AWS noaa-jpss carries only raw SDR granules and BHP fire products, no cloud-free DNB composites. Substitute in this stack: GLS built-up fraction as the demand-density proxy.

Hansen Global Forest Change: reachable anonymously through the GCS JSON API (bucket earthenginepartners-hansen, prefix Annual_Layers_2015_2024/TCH/<year>/), but the tiles are 10x10 degrees at ~84 MB median, so covering Russia needs ~7 GB for a single year. Deferred; forest share comes from GLS-LC100 classes and ESA WorldCover tree classes instead.
WorldClim: biogeo.ucdavis.edu / data.worldclim.org are not resolvable from this host. Available through Earth Engine (WORLDCLIM/V1/BIO, an Image, 19 bands) - used in the GEE pipeline.

SoilGrids: neither the Earth Engine asset (ISRIC/soilgrids, ISRIC/soigrid) nor the WCS endpoint (maps.isric.org map paths rejected by msLoadMap) is reachable here; per-tile files are browsable at files.isric.org/soilgrids/latest/data but 1129 tiles per layer is too much for the deadline.
